title: l’m leaving for a while - finally going on a little honeymoon vacation
en: I'm leaving my little home for a while. So, in preparation, I gathered the last remnants of the harvest. I managed to get some potatoes and carrots from my father's garden, and also planted some lilies that my mother-in-law so kindly suggested. My garden and plot are still a long way from the fabulous place I imagine, but it's so exciting to start this process. I always remember that saying: "The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago." The second best time is today." Does n't this apply to our goals as well? We may regret not pursuing them sooner, but now is the best time to start again. I will miss you all while

I am gone. Maybe the frost will hit before I get back, but I'll be back soon The day was so peaceful, but as soon as I turned on the camera, almost every dog ​​in the area started barking. Hi , I wanted to make a very short, but hopefully enjoyable

video about me going away for a while. I won't be there , but I will definitely be back. Luke and I are trying to get ourselves a little vacation for a few days to celebrate our honeymoon, which we weren't able to do in May when we got married. We both went to work the Monday after the wedding. We got married on Saturday, went to work on Monday , and we just didn't have a chance to take some time for ourselves, so now we're going to the coast, visit his aunt, and hopefully stay at a really cute bed and breakfast, which I hope to share with you when I get back, unpack, and get back to normal . We are celebrating our engagement anniversary, and we are also just happy that

we are together, healthy, and happy. I was constantly in and out of the hospital, and this cycle of visits to doctors continues, so it's a little tiring, sometimes frustrating, but what is is, and that's why I really appreciate the opportunity now to go somewhere, breathe fresh air, continue my journey to healing, and I'm really looking forward to it. It's so important to be grateful and truly love and appreciate every moment, because you never know what life will have in store for you in the next minute. I really always miss filming my videos when I'm away, so I wanted to do at least something small now,

even though I'm short on time this week before the meeting. I send you all my love. Thank you again for all your kind words and messages. This means a lot to me, and we'll see each other very soon. Take care of yourself. See you later.
zh: 我要离开我的小家一段时间。因此，在准备过程中，我收集了最后的收获。我设法从父亲的花园里弄到了一些土豆和胡萝卜，还种了一些我婆婆好心建议的百合花。我的花园和地块距离我想象中的美妙地方还有很长的路要走，但开始这个过程真是令人兴奋。我一直记得这样一句话：“种一棵树最好的时间是20年前”。第二个最好的时间是今天。”这不也适用于我们的目标吗？我们可能会后悔没有早点追求它们，但现在是重新开始的最好时机。我会一直想念你的。
我走了。也许在我回来之前霜冻就来了，但是我很快就会回来。 日子是那么平静，但是当我打开相机时，该地区几乎所有的狗都开始吠叫。嗨，我想做一个很短但希望令人愉快的
关于我离开一段时间的视频。我不会去那里，但我一定会回来的。卢克和我想给自己放几天假来庆祝我们的蜜月，但我们五月份结婚时没能做到这一点。婚礼后的星期一我们都去上班。我们周六结婚，周一上班，我们只是没有机会为自己腾出一些时间，所以现在我们要去海边，拜访他的阿姨，并希望住在一个非常可爱的住宿加早餐酒店，我希望当我回来，打开行李，恢复正常时与你们分享。我们正在庆祝我们的订婚周年纪念日，我们也很高兴
我们在一起，健康快乐。我经常进出医院，这种看医生的循环还在继续，所以有点累，有时令人沮丧，但事实就是如此，这就是为什么我真的很感激现在有机会去某个地方，呼吸新鲜空气，继续我的康复之旅，我真的很期待它。感恩、真正热爱和欣赏每一刻非常重要，因为你永远不知道下一分钟生活会为你准备什么。我真的总是怀念我不在的时候拍摄我的视频，所以我现在想做至少一些小事，
尽管这周开会前我的时间很短。我把我所有的爱都送给你。再次感谢您的所有客气话和留言。这对我来说意义重大，我们很快就会见面。照顾好你自己。稍后见。
